The audit trail is stored in a ConfigMap named 'audit-trail' in namespace dojo-sec-forensics. Run: kubectl get configmap audit-trail -n dojo-sec-forensics -o jsonpath='{.data.log}'
Look for lines with verb=get and resource=secrets in the audit trail. The attacker read TWO secrets — one is a decoy (app-config), the other contains the flag. Find the second secret name.
kubectl get secret attacker-secret -n dojo-sec-forensics -o jsonpath='{.data.flag}' | base64 -d
